basic_details.notification_number: 02/Ad-hoc Senior Resident/Dept of Conservative Dentistry and Endodontics/PGIDER/IGIMS/Estt./2026
basic_details.short_information: Indira Gandhi Institute of Medical Sciences, Patna (IGIMS), Bihar, has invited applications for the post of Senior Resident (Conservative Dentistry and Endodontics) under Advt No. 02/Ad-hoc Senior Resident/Dept of Conservative Dentistry and Endodontics/PGIDER/IGIMS/Estt./2026. Selection is through a walk-in interview on 17 November 2026.

application_fee.details: Payment mode: Demand Draft payable to The Director, IGIMS, Patna.

age_limit.age_details: Maximum 45 years (as on the date of Interview)

qualification.education_qualification: MDS in Conservative Dentistry and Endodontics.
qualification.details: Qualification: MDS in Conservative Dentistry and Endodontics Age limit: Maximum 45 years (as on the date of Interview) Age relaxation: SC/ST 5 years, EBC/BC 3 years, Female candidates (all categories) 3 years | Other conditions: | Only Indian citizens may attend Reservation benefit applies to Bihar State domicile candidates only Post is non-practising; private practice of any kind, including laboratory, is prohibited Stay in campus is compulsory if accommodation is provided; otherwise HRA as per rules

salary_details.pay_scale: As per the Institution's Rules; Pay + NPA plus other allowances as per rule

how_to_apply: Download the application form from www.igims.org.
Fill the application form in the prescribed proforma.
Get a Demand Draft of Rs.1000/- (UR/EWS/BC) or Rs.250/- (SC/ST/EBC) payable to The Director, IGIMS, Patna.
Attach copies of all supporting certificates and documents.
Report up to 10.00 AM on 17-11-2026 at the chamber of HOD, Dept. of Conservative Dentistry and Endodontics, PGIDER, IGIMS, Patna-14.
Bring all originals, and thesis and publication as a PPT in a pen-drive.
important_instructions: Number of vacancies may increase or decrease If eligible female candidates are unavailable (where applicable), male candidates may be considered No TA/DA for attending the interview Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification Declaration on NMC Declaration form and appearance before NMC Team for 2026-27 must be submitted Merit selection does not give right of appointment

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: MDS in Conservative Dentistry and Endodontics Age limit: Maximum 45 years (as on the date of Interview) Age relaxation: SC/ST 5 years, EBC/BC 3 years, Female candidates (all categories) 3 years Other conditions: Only Indian citizens may attend Reservation benefit applies to Bihar State domicile candidates only Post is non-practising; private practice of any kind, including laboratory, is prohibited Stay in campus is compulsory if accommodation is provided; otherwise HRA as per rules

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for IGIMS Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applicants from outside Bihar are not entitled to reservation Employed candidates without a No Objection Certificate will not be considered for selection

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Pay Scale as per the Institution's Rules; Pay + NPA with other allowances as per rule. Ad-hoc appointment under the 89 days Sr. Residency Programme Legal bond: one month's emoluments for every year of the programme not completed on leaving mid-way Appointment terminated if found doing private practice

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: Payment mode: Demand Draft payable to The Director, IGIMS, Patna.

rows.event: Walk-in reporting (up to 10.00 AM) and document verification

content_sections.heading: How Will IGIMS Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Document verification on the same day before the interview Walk-in interview with PowerPoint presentation of thesis and publication Marking out of 100 marks; selection by the Selection Committee based on bio-data Document verification before the interview on the same day Marking out of 100: BDS 10, MDS 10, additional qualification 10, publications 10, poster/presentation 10, awards 10, training 10, project 10, subject knowledge 20 Minimum qualifying: UR 50th percentile, BC/EBC/EWS 45th percentile, SC/ST 40th percentile Selection Committee selects candidates based on bio-data

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Application form in the prescribed proforma with recent photograph Copies of all supporting certificates and all originals in proof of age, qualification and registration Thesis and publication as a PowerPoint presentation in a pen-drive Demand Draft for the application form cost NOC from employer if employed, or written statement of not being employed nor doing any course Caste, creamy layer, domicile or EWS certificate from the Circle Officer, Bihar, if claiming reservation; NMC declaration

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IGIMS Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Download the application form from www.igims.org. Fill the application form in the prescribed proforma. Get a Demand Draft of Rs.1000/- (UR/EWS/BC) or Rs.250/- (SC/ST/EBC) payable to The Director, IGIMS, Patna. Attach copies of all supporting certificates and documents. Report up to 10.00 AM on 17-11-2026 at the chamber of HOD, Dept. of Conservative Dentistry and Endodontics, PGIDER, IGIMS, Patna-14. Bring all originals, and thesis and publication as a PPT in a pen-drive.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Number of vacancies may increase or decrease If eligible female candidates are unavailable (where applicable), male candidates may be considered No TA/DA for attending the interview Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification Declaration on NMC Declaration form and appearance before NMC Team for 2026-27 must be submitted Merit selection does not give right of appointment

faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for IGIMS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 17 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in IGIMS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Senior Resident (Conservative Dentistry and Endodontics).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for IGIMS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 17 November 2026. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: UR/EWS/BC: Rs. 1000 (cost of application form, non-refundable). SC/ST/EBC: Rs. 250 (cost of application form, non-refundable).

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 45 years (as on the date of Interview). Relaxation: SC/ST 5 years, EBC/BC 3 years, Female candidates (all categories) 3 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: As per the Institution's Rules; Pay + NPA plus other allowances as per rule.

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: MDS in Conservative Dentistry and Endodontics.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Only Indian citizens may attend. Reservation benefit applies to Bihar State domicile candidates only. Post is non-practising; private practice of any kind, including laboratory, is prohibited. Stay in campus is compulsory if accommodation is provided; otherwise HRA as per rules.

faq.question: Q9. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applicants from outside Bihar are not entitled to reservation. Employed candidates without a No Objection Certificate will not be considered for selection.

faq.question: Q10. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Document verification on the same day before the interview. Walk-in interview with PowerPoint presentation of thesis and publication. Marking out of 100 marks; selection by the Selection Committee based on bio-data. Document verification before the interview on the same day.
